channel.title: AWS What's New - Community Portal Mirror
channel.description: Mirror of recent AWS product and feature announcements, republished with CORS enabled for the AWS Community Portal.

item.title: Amazon EC2 R8i instances are now available in additional Regions
item.author: community-portal@example.com
item.description:
Memory-optimized R8i instances are now available in three additional Regions. These instances suit in-memory databases, real-time analytics, and workloads that benefit from higher memory bandwidth.

To get started, see the Amazon EC2 product page for Region availability and pricing.

item.title: AWS Lambda increases the maximum ephemeral storage per function
item.author: community-portal@example.com
item.description:
Functions can now be configured with a larger /tmp allocation, which helps workloads that stage files during execution such as media processing and data transformation.

There is no additional charge to configure a larger allocation; you pay only for storage actually used. See the AWS Lambda documentation to configure it.

item.title: Amazon Bedrock adds new foundation models for text and embeddings
item.author: community-portal@example.com
item.description:
Additional text-generation and embedding models are available through a single API, with the same request shape as existing models so switching requires only a model identifier change.

Availability varies by Region. Review the model catalog before enabling one in production.

item.title: Amazon DynamoDB reduces on-demand throughput pricing
item.author: community-portal@example.com
item.description: On-demand read and write request pricing is reduced in all commercial Regions. The change applies automatically with no action required, and appears on the next billing cycle.

item.title: AWS Support Center console introduces a refreshed case experience
item.author: community-portal@example.com
item.description: The case list and case detail views have been reorganized to surface correspondence and attachments more directly. No migration is required and existing cases are unaffected.

item.title: Amazon S3 Express One Zone expands to additional Regions
item.author: community-portal@example.com

item.title: Amazon OpenSearch Service improves vector search performance and reduces memory footprint
item.author: community-portal@example.com
item.description:
Vector search now uses a revised index layout that lowers the memory required to serve approximate nearest-neighbour queries at a given recall target. Benchmarks on high-dimensional embedding workloads show reduced resident memory with comparable recall.

The improvement is most noticeable for collections where the vector index previously did not fit in memory and queries spilled to disk. Specific gains depend on dimensionality, dataset size, and the recall target configured for the index.

Key points:

  • No change to the query API - existing k-NN queries work unmodified.
  • Existing indexes continue to serve traffic during migration.
  • Re-indexing is optional but recommended to realize the full benefit.

See the Amazon OpenSearch Service documentation for migration guidance.

item.title: AWS Identity & Access Management adds new condition keys for tag-based access control
item.author: community-portal@example.com
item.description:
New condition keys let you write policies that compare resource tags against principal tags, so a single policy can cover teams that own separately tagged resources.

Existing policies continue to evaluate unchanged. Review the condition key reference before adopting them in a permissions boundary.

item.title: Amazon CloudWatch adds a metrics explorer saved-view shortcut
item.author: community-portal@example.com
item.description: Saved views can now be opened directly from the metrics explorer toolbar. This sample item deliberately carries no pubDate.
